title: Dorcas
html:
Dorcas

Dorcas is a troublemaking child around Townston. He partakes in activities such as listening to vulgar music. His parents don't pay enough attention to him either.

He runs randomly around Townston, and if you talk to him, he tells you that "You smell like poopie!"

But, believe it or not, he is actually a quest giver. If you find him in the right mood he will ask you to do a Candy Run!!
